transcript: COPD is chronic obstructive pulmonary disease
ARDS is acute respiratory distress syndrome

RDW is red cell distribution width

NICU is neonatal intensive care unit
PICU is pediatric intensive care unit
SICU is surgical intensive care unit
MICU is medical intensive care unit
TID is three times a day
QID is four times a day
QHS is every night at bedtime
D5NS is 5% dextrose in normal saline
ADL is activities of daily living
HEENT is head, eyes, ears, nose, and throat
PERRLA is pupils equal, round, reactive to light and accommodation
RRR is regular rate and rhythm
CABG is coronary artery bypass graft
PTCA is percutaneous transluminal coronary angioplasty
LBBB is left bundle branch block
RBBB is right bundle branch block
LVEF is left ventricular ejection fraction
ACLS is advanced cardiovascular life support
PALS is pediatric advanced life support
ATLS is advanced trauma life support
FiO2 is fraction of inspired oxygen
BiPAP is bilevel positive airway pressure
CPAP is continuous positive airway pressure
PIC is peripherally inserted central catheter
